metadata.question: Did Cambodia experience forest loss between 2001 and 2014?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Hansen Global Forest Change dataset which has annual forest loss data - Focus on Cambodia boundary - Compare forest loss between 2001 and 2014 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed (Hansen dataset is a composite product) - Use the 'lossyear' band which indicates the year of forest loss (1-23 for 2001-2023) - Filter for loss years between 1 and 14 (representing 2001-2014) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero (B): If total forest loss pixels = 0, means no forest loss - Non-zero (A): If forest loss pixels > 0, means forest loss occurred - C2: If no valid pixels after processing (unlikely with Hansen dataset) - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN/invalid value ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry Definition - Cambodia const cambodia = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Cambodia')) .geometry(); // 2. Data Acquisition - Hansen Global Forest Change const hansen = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2023_v1_11'); // Get the loss year band (1-23 represents years 2001-2023) const lossYear = hansen.select('lossyear'); // 3. Filter for forest loss between 2001 and 2014 (years 1-14) const loss2001_2014 = lossYear.gte(1).and(lossYear.lte(14)); // 4. Calculate total forest loss pixels const lossStats = loss2001_2014.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: cambodia, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const totalLossPixels = lossStats.get('lossyear').getInfo(); // Also get count of valid pixels to check for C2 const pixelCount = loss2001_2014.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: cambodia, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const validPixels = pixelCount.get('lossyear').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Output console.log(`Valid pixels analyzed: ${validPixels}`); console.log(`Forest loss pixels (2001-2014): ${totalLossPixels}`); if (totalLossPixels === null || totalLossPixels === undefined || isNaN(totalLossPixels)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (validPixels === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (totalLossPixels > 0) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
